description: This Harvard Dataverse resource pairs a subset of the Arizona Hot Serial Cereal wheat experiment with results from thirty AgMIP wheat models. Eleven planting dates over two years were selected to avoid frost effects, with infrared warming and supplemental irrigation on selected plantings. The data include weather, soils, crop measurements and cultivar information, plus daily and end-of-season model outputs. The repository API confirms a RAR distribution under CC0 for free reuse. It can benchmark temperature-response and irrigation-demand simulations. Coverage is limited to one cultivar and experiment, and selecting frost-free treatments restricts conclusions about cold-season performance. No directly related catalogue resource was found.
name: Data from the Hot Serial Cereal Experiment for modeling wheat response to temperature: field experiments and AgMIP-Wheat multi-model simulations
